—Day of Week Breakdown?Performance by weekday — which days are your edge. WR = win rate. W/L/BE = win/loss/break-even counts. Net R = sum of R across trades on that day.

—By Symbol?Performance per instrument you trade. WR = win rate. Net R = total R. Avg R = expectancy per trade. Net = money result. Sorted most to least profitable. Appears once you've traded more than one symbol.

—Trade Time Analysis

When you trade best, worst, and most often. Bucket size adapts to your sample size — narrower as you log more trades.

—Session Analysis

How you perform per FX session, by entry time (London clock). London 08:00–16:30 and New York 13:30–21:00 genuinely overlap, so a trade in the 13:30–16:30 window counts toward both — the overlap is also shown on its own.

—Showed up vs Traded
—Consistency Rule

How much of your total profit came from your single best day, against the cap you set in Settings.

—Hold Winners longer VS close BEs sooner??Compares two alternative rules against your actual trades: (A) holding winners longer based on how much of the move you typically capture, and (B) using a shorter TP based on how far price extends on your BEs before reversing. Replays your history under each rule and shows which direction is more profitable AND which improves win rate. Tier badges show conviction (too few / early / building / strong) based on sample size. Detailed per-trade breakdown is collapsed below — expand to see exactly which trades drive each recommendation.
—Setups Performance

Which of your setups actually pays, ranked by Net R — with win rate and expectancy, so a big total earned by one outlier doesn't read like an edge. One setup per trade, so these rows sum to your lifetime totals.

Auto-sync from your EA
Pulls closed trades sent by the Minimalist Manager EA — no file needed.
In MT5 desktop, open the Toolbox → History tab. Right-click the table → choose your timeframe (e.g. "Custom Period") → right-click again → Report → Open in Web. Save the resulting .html file and drop it on the Manual sync panel.
Copy your token from the MT5 sync token shown below and paste it into the EA's Inputs the first time you open Minimalist Manager:
• scroll down to the bottom
• in the empty field 'Your Session Tool sync token (account id)' paste your token, then press OK
Leave the Endpoint fields as they are. Then in MT5 open Tools > Options > Expert Advisors, tick 'Allow WebRequest for listed URL' and add the WebRequest URL below (the whole address — it covers both trade sync and the live session feed). Make sure Algo Trading is also ON.

Finishing a session hides the live screen for the rest of the day. Reopen it to run Session Live again — as often as you like (you must be inside your session Times above).

Define the limits you commit to. The app checks each trade against these and reflects rule-following or rule-breaking in your bias and session-review greetings. Leave a field blank to skip that rule.

Loads a firm's typical Phase 1 rules (daily loss, max drawdown, profit target) as a starting point — adjust to your exact account, and always verify against your firm's current rules. You can also set your own values and save them as a reusable preset.

% of balance

Your account's overall loss limit from the starting balance — the line that fails a funded challenge. Drives the drawdown-headroom line in your greetings.

% of balance

When today's net loss (including costs) exceeds this, you've broken the rule. Pick whichever unit fits how you think about risk — % of balance or money amount.

% of balance

Per-trade risk cap. If any logged trade risks more than this limit, you've broken the rule.

% of balance

The profit target for the account, from your starting balance. The app tracks your progress toward it in your greetings.

% of balance

When your broker's trades auto-import, a net result within this band of zero is logged as break-even (BE) rather than a small win or loss. Set as % of balance or a fixed amount.

Number of trades you allow yourself per session before stopping, win or lose. Helps prevent overtrading and revenge trades.

% of total profit

Most prop firms cap how much of your total profit can come from a single day — commonly 40% or 50%. Set the cap and the app tracks your biggest day against it. It's a ratio, so you can't fix a breach by cutting a past day: you clear it by adding profit on other days.

Add account

Adds a parallel active account. Use this when you trade multiple accounts simultaneously (e.g. several funded accounts mirrored by a trade copier). Both accounts stay active.

Linked groups

Bundle accounts together so one trade entry fans out to all of them at once. Mirrors how a trade copier works. Each duplicated trade is independently editable.

Admin only — AI usage per member. Simple questions run on cheap Haiku; smart ones on Sonnet. Click a trader for their day / week / month breakdown.
